command:
set -eu
echo '=== SERVICE ==='
systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p ActiveEnterTimestamp -p DropInPaths -p ExecCondition -p ExecStopPost --no-pager
echo '=== GUARDS ==='
for f in /usr/local/libexec/entityos/fluechtig-vor-start-pruefen.sh /usr/local/libexec/entityos/semantic-state-cutover.py /etc/systemd/system/entityos-vm.service.d/10-volatile-state-guard.conf /etc/systemd/system/entityos-vm.service.d/20-semantic-state-cutover.conf; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then sha256sum "$f"; else echo MISSING:$f; fi; done
echo '=== CONFIG ==='
grep -E '^(ENTITYOS_ROOTFS_RUN|ENTITYOS_DATA_DIR|ENTITYOS_IDENTITY_BINDS)=' /etc/entityos/entityos.conf || true
echo '=== MANIFEST ==='
if [ -f /var/lib/entityos/data/semantic-state/CUTOVER.json ]; then sha256sum /var/lib/entityos/data/semantic-state/CUTOVER.json; sed -n '1,80p' /var/lib/entityos/data/semantic-state/CUTOVER.json; else echo CUTOVER_MANIFEST_MISSING; fi
echo '=== SOURCE DB WRITERS ==='
for p in /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/consciousness.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/amygdala.db /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share/frank/db/world_experience.db; do echo DB:$p; stat -c 'SIZE=%s MTIME=%y' "$p" 2>/dev/null || true; fuser "$p" 2>/dev/null || true; done
echo OMEGA_CUTOVER_PREFLIGHT_DONE=1
